description: PARTNER KEY ONLY: read the notes DC Hub left for the partner agent whose key this session sends — up to 20 unread, newest first, marked read on delivery (peek=true reads without marking). Call it at the start of a session. Proxies GET /api/v1/inbox with the session's own key: no key answers key required; a key issued without a partner slug answers partner key required (403). Not a data tool: it returns no market, power, fiber or siting figures.

peek.description: true = read without marking the notes read
